title: The visible side
notes: First routes, in 35-40 minutes at the tables after the launch and four to six paired rounds (page 2): K-1 P1-3 for the six-face possibilities and ticket removals; grades 2-3 P1-3 for the four pairs and both visible clues; grades 4-5 P1-3 for conditional weights and what a fact about the covered number reveals. On return, K-1 can add tickets or design a cup (P4-7). Grades 2-3 can compare chooser rules or find all fair two-ticket cups (P4-6). Grades 4-5 can compare the choosers (P4-5), then characterize every fair subset and the whole-card obstruction (P6-7). Grades 4-5 can then continue with the bonus companion, week-45-bonus.pdf with its own guide: repeated clues from the same card, two door hosts and a noisy reporter; grades 2-3 can try its first page. Keep the screen protocol unchanged so the mathematical clue remains color alone.
